name: TP4056
description: TP4056 リチウムイオン電池 1セル リニア充電IC (ESOP-8, ピン1=TEMP 2=PROG 3=GND 4=VCC 5=BAT 6=/STDBY 7=/CHRG 8=CE、裏のパッドはGND)。充電電流 = 1200 ÷ R_PROG[Ω] [A] (1.2kΩで1A)。プリチャージ(2.9V未満は1/10の電流)→定電流→4.2Vの定電圧の動作を再現する動作モデル。TEMP(温度検出)・熱制限・再充電は扱いません。数値は概算

sim.name: TP4056
sim.text:
.subckt TP4056 temp prog gnd vcc bat stdby chrg ce
* TP4056 behavioural model
* Linear Li-ion charger as a behavioural model: pre-charge, constant current, constant voltage.
* Control signals are scaled so that 1 V = 1 A. Amplifiers and "the smaller one wins" selectors are
* made of controlled sources and switches, as in the NE555 model.
Vref1 r1 gnd DC 1.0
Vref0 r0 gnd DC 0.1
V29 v29 gnd DC 2.9
V37 v37 gnd DC 3.7
V40 v40 gnd DC 4.0
V15 v15 gnd DC 1.5
V01 v01 gnd DC 0.1
Vreg vreg gnd DC 4.2
* PROG reference: 1 V for constant current, 0.1 V while the cell is deeply discharged
Rrf rf gnd 1k
Sr1 r1 rf bat v29 SWC
Sr0 r0 rf v29 bat SWC
* error amplifiers: current loop (PROG held at the reference) and voltage loop (cell voltage)
Ea ea gnd rf prog 1000
Eb eb gnd vreg bat 20
* the smaller one wins
Rm m gnd 1k
Sma ea m eb ea SWC
Smb eb m ea eb SWC
* only positive, only when VCC is high enough, above the cell and enabled
Sx m n1 m gnd SWC
Sg1 n1 n2 vcc bo SWC
Sg2 n2 n3 vcc v37 SWC
Sg3 n3 u ce v15 SWC
Rl u gnd 1k
Rn1 n1 gnd 1Meg
Rn2 n2 gnd 1Meg
Rn3 n3 gnd 1Meg
Vbo bo bat DC 0.3
* pass element: the charge current, and its image (1200x smaller) out of PROG
Gb vcc bat u gnd 1
Gp gnd prog u gnd 0.000833333333
* status (open drain): low while charging (PROG above 0.1 V or the cell not yet full)
Sc1 chrg c1 prog v01 SWO
Sc2 c1 gnd vcc v37 SWO
Sc3 chrg c2 v40 bat SWO
Sc4 c2 gnd vcc v37 SWO
Ss1 stdby s1 bat v40 SWO
Ss2 s1 s2 v01 prog SWO
Ss3 s2 gnd vcc v37 SWO
Rc1 c1 gnd 100Meg
Rc2 c2 gnd 100Meg
Rs1 s1 gnd 100Meg
Rs2 s2 gnd 100Meg
Riq vcc gnd 20k
Rt temp gnd 100Meg
.model SWC SW(RON=1 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.005)
.model SWO SW(RON=60 ROFF=1G VT=0 VW=0.005)
.ends TP4056
limits: 充電の3段階 (プリチャージ・定電流・定電圧) と状態表示を、外から見た動きだけで再現する動作モデルです。
電池は、小さなコンデンサで代用してください (値に IC=3.2 と書くと、その電圧から始まります)。実物の電池は容量が桁違いに大きく、放電特性も複雑です。
扱わないもの: 温度による制限と TEMP 端子、再充電のしきい値、充電タイマ、入力の逆接続保護、熱による電流の自動的な低下。
電流の式 (1200 ÷ R) は代表値です。実物の電流は、個体や温度でばらつきます。
